ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white/light grey) and 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white/light-grey mottling dominates the interior of the left lobe and lower portion of the right lobe; a wide, low-intensity black vertical band occupies the central area surrounding the notch; numerous high-contrast black linear streaks intersect the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; estimated pixel-based interior angle of approximately 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; numerous small peaks and valleys (3-8 pixel amplitude) along the primary edge, with several larger notch-like depressions on the outer trailing edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve extending from the median notch, flattening toward the mid-lobe, and ending in an upward-tapered distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white pixel clusters representing barnacle colonization located at the distal tips of both lobes; isolated circular white spots visible on the black pigment of the central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths (10-50 pixels) crossing the white pigmented areas of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of sessile barnacles at the fluke tips; multiple irregular notches on the trailing edge suggesting mechanical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, dark circular marking located on the lower interior quadrant of the left lobe, surrounded by white pigmentation.
